title: Public Schema Discipline
summary: Treat public as a shared compatibility namespace and know that PostgreSQL 15 stopped granting CREATE on public to PUBLIC by default.
learning_objectives: Lock down the public schema on older clusters.
Explain the PostgreSQL 15 public CREATE behavior change.
Move application objects out of public unless there is a deliberate reason.
reflection_prompts: Which permission would you remove first if this role were leaked?
What SQL evidence would you attach to an access review?
